sub: For Intercessors, Prayer Warriors, Prayer Teams, Prayer Partners, Prayer Ministry Leaders, and Prayer Chain Members

hook.h2: You carry people to your Father who may never know you prayed for them. He hears every name you bring
hook.text: Our Father said, “If I find fifty righteous within the city of Sodom, I’ll spare the whole place for them.”
father: “If I find fifty righteous within the city of Sodom, I’ll spare the whole place for them.”
hook.note: Abraham stood before our Father and asked for a city that was not his own. Fifty, forty-five, forty, thirty, twenty, ten. Each time he asked again, and each time our Father answered. You are not interrupting Him. He has been listening for you, and He answers.

short350: Intercessors and prayer warriors, prayer teams, watchmen on the wall and every parent on their knees: the Intercessor's Bible from Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) is the Holy Bible made for you.

Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color™ is a complete Bible, Old and New Testaments, in a fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek that reveals God as your Father. It is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's words in RED, the Spirit's words in PURPLE.
It equips you to receive the Father, hear His voice, and know His heart is for you.

For intercessors and prayer warriors, prayer teams and prayer partners, prayer chain members, spiritual warfare intercessors, healing prayer ministers, house of prayer communities, watchmen and praying parents. For every name you carry: families, prodigals, the sick, leaders, nations, missionaries and the lost.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often, and until now every word He spoke was printed in black. Now you can see Him speak on every page.

An intercessor stands before our Father for others — for family, for the church, for the city and the nations — often unseen, often through the night. Our Father invited exactly that: "Call to me, and I'll answer, and tell you great, hidden things you don't know." (Jeremiah 33:3) And the Son gave the praying few His promise: "if two of you on earth agree about anything they ask, my Father in heaven will do it for them" (Matthew 18:19). This is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God — for the prayer room, the prayer meeting, and the quiet hours when you carry someone before Him.
An interpretive translation with a stated theological emphasis: the revelation of God as Father. Not a paraphrase — every word is rendered from the original Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

long.h: He Has Been Speaking The Whole Time
body: For a hundred and twenty-five years, the red letter Bible has shown you the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often, and until now every word He spoke was printed in black. Now you can see Him speak on every page. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.

long.h: You Stand Before Him For Others. He Asked You To Call.
body: An intercessor stands before our Father for others — for family, for the church, for the city and the nations — often unseen, often through the night. Our Father invited exactly that: "Call to me, and I'll answer, and tell you great, hidden things you don't know." (Jeremiah 33:3)

And the Son gave the praying few His promise: "if two of you on earth agree about anything they ask, my Father in heaven will do it for them" (Matthew 18:19). This is a devotional Bible for daily Bible reading and intimacy with God — for the prayer room, the prayer meeting, and the quiet hours when you carry someone before Him.

God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal. This translation lets the Hebrew and Greek speak the distinction they always made: Abba Father, your Heavenly Father, and you, His beloved son or daughter. If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

faq.q: What makes the Intercessor's Bible different from the other editions?
faq.a: It is the complete Father's Heart Bible™ in Divine Voice Color — every book, every page, nothing abridged — with a cover and opening pages made for an intercessor. Those pages include a dedication, Where to Turn, and a presentation page for their name. Everything from Genesis 1:1 onward is the same Bible every other edition carries.

faq.q: Is the Intercessor's Bible a complete Bible?
faq.a: Yes. All 66 books, 1,189 chapters and 31,085 verses, 890 pages, full color throughout. An introduction opens each book, a Father's note and short prayer closes each one, and 1,355 study notes run through the whole Bible.

faq.q: Is it a good gift for intercessors?
faq.a: It is made for it. A 6 x 9 Bible in hardcover or paperback with a presentation page for their name, in a cover made for intercessors rather than a generic pew edition.

For a hundred and twenty-five years red letters have shown the Son speaking. Our Father speaks more than three times as often — 128,579 words across 5,615 verses — and until now those words were printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. In Divine Voice Color you see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. More than one word in four of the Bible is a divine person speaking. The color is a mark of ownership, not of quotation — His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, and words He never spoke are never colored.
